Title: REINVENT 4 Mol2MolMediumSimilarity
Description: Produces about 100 novel structures bearing moderate similarity to a query molecule, populating the space around a starting point without straying far from it. A medium-similarity Mol2Mol prior from REINVENT 4 drives the generation, one of several transformer-based priors in an open framework that also supports linker design, scaffold hopping and R-group replacement. Decoding uses beam search rather than random sampling, so a given input always returns the same set, which still needs filtering for novelty and synthetic feasibility.
Interpretation: Up to 100 generated molecules of moderate structural similarity to the input compound.
